vehicle.notes: UK RHD. VW LH/RH = vehicle's own left/right (LH = UK nearside/passenger side, RH = offside/driver side). Numbers come from web-search result titles/summaries of the cited pages; page fetches were blocked, and the shared web-search budget ran out part-way, so coverage is partial: front bumper suffixes, grilles, fog lamps, mirrors, doors, rear bumper, rear lamps, tailgate, cooling pack, sensors, wheels and TPMS were not researched. Many sources are breaker or replacement-panel listings quoting the OE number. Use the 5H2 941 ... (RHD) headlamps listed here; 5H1 941 ... headlamps were described as left-hand-drive in search results. Facelift (Mk8.5, 2024-) numbers are marked in notes; most numbers here are pre-facelift. Verify every number by VIN.

parts.description: Front bumper cover: base number only (suffix varies by trim/sensors)
parts.notes: Base number seen on UK breaker listings of used painted Golf 8 front bumpers across trims, e.g. a Golf R bumper: https://www.ebay.co.uk/itm/405116540756. Suffixed numbers (G, H, J, AA; GRU = primed) appeared in search summaries but could not be tied to a listing. Not orderable as-is: take the full number from the VIN.

parts.description: Front bumper cover, primed (GRU): GTI per fitment shown
parts.notes: Australian (RHD) genuine-parts retailer page 'Volkswagen Golf genuine front bar 01/2021 to' (number taken from the page address); the search result showed fitment 'Hatch GTI Automatic 2.0L 4Cyl Turbo Petrol 4Dr FWD 10/2021-11/2022'. Not seen on a UK listing; fit to other trims and to Mk8.5 not verified.

UK listing 'VOLKSWAGEN GOLF MK8 2020 - 2023 FRONT BONNET PRIMED BRAND NEW OE 5H0823031G' (appears to be a new replacement panel quoting the OE number). Also https://www.ebay.co.uk/itm/305497418249 ('Bonnet for VW GOLF 19- 5H0823031G'). UK search results also showed listings giving 5H0823031H as an interchangeable number (see that entry). Mk8.5 fit not verified.

US used-parts listing: 2024 Golf GTI hood, part number 5H0823031H. Also paintedautoparts.com (GTI 2022, OEM 5H0823031H): https://paintedautoparts.com/volkswagen-gti-hood-oem-5h0823031h-2022-pl-vw1230158.html, and a used 2025 (Mk8.5) GTI hood with the same number: https://schramauto.com/parts/VOLKSWAGEN/GOLF_GTI/SS0278/2025/HOOD/3649305. UK eBay search results quoted it as interchangeable with 5H0823031G. Only US listings tied to a link.

UK listing 'Volkswagen Golf Mk8 1.5 TSI Front Left Bonnet Hood Hinge 5H0823301 2020'. Caution: another UK listing (https://www.ebay.co.uk/itm/227495720902) calls 5H0823301 the drivers side, but an Australian (RHD) listing gives 5H0823302 as the drivers-side hinge, which supports 301 = left. Check the side before ordering.

Australian (RHD) genuine-parts listing 'Volkswagen Golf genuine bonnet hinge drivers side 01/2021 to' (number taken from the page address); the driver's side on an Australian RHD car is the right. Not seen on a UK listing.

parts.description: Bonnet seal (rubber seal between scuttle and bonnet)
parts.notes: Used-parts listing 'VW Volkswagen Golf 8 seal scuttle bonnet engine cover rubber gasket 5H0823723'. Single source.

US listing: Golf R 2022 left fender, OEM 5H0821021B. Also an EU aftermarket 'analog' listing for a 'VW Golf 22-26' front left wing quoting 5H0821021B: https://aletoparts.com/detail/front-left-wing-vw-golf-22-26/. UK eBay search results also showed passenger-side Mk8 wings quoting 5H0821021B, and a 2023 GTI left wing quoting 5H0821021F (links not captured), so the suffix may have changed. Mk8.5 fit not verified.

UK listing for a new painted (replacement) Mk8 driver's-side wing, 2020 on, quoting OE/OEM number 5H0 821 022 A. Also US listings for a GTI/Golf R 2022 right fender, OEM 5H0821022A: https://paintedautoparts.com/catalog/product/view/id/68523/s/volkswagen-gti-fender-right-oem-5h0821022a-2022. Mk8.5 fit not verified.
Listing 'New VW GOLF CD MK8 Front Right Fender Holder 5H0821430'. Exact mounting position of the holder not stated. Single source.
